138	variable (C) in
139	/-- **COV-1 input 1: the twisted class splits, and its presenting Čech class is named.**
140	
141	If the untwisted plus class `μ` over the field `K` is presented over the finite separable
142	extension `L/K` by the Čech class `M₀`, then the *twisted* class
143	`μ · thetaFamily (chartTwistClass m Z)` is presented over the SAME `L` by
144	
145	  `M₀ · CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z)`.
146	
147	No second extension, no common refinement of covers: the twist factor is honest over every
148	base (`picEtAffineEquiv_thetaFamily_eq_unit_relPicMk`), so it passes through the splitting
149	of `μ` untouched, as a multiplicative factor of the presenting class.
150	
151	This is what makes the degree of the presenting class computable, which is what `w4-datb`
152	§1.2 steps 2–4 spend: `classDeg L` of the second factor is `classDeg k (chartTwistClass)`
153	by E-iv-alg, hence `m·d₁ − deg Z`.  A bare `∃ M` splitting would leave that unavailable. -/
154	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit
155	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
156	    [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
157	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
158	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
159	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
160	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
161	    PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K
162	        (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k K)))
163	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
164	          (M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))) := by
165	  -- the twist factor's fibre at `L`: honest over `K`, then transported to `L`
166	  have hθ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K
167	        (thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k K)))
168	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
169	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))) := by
170	    rw [picEtAffineEquiv_thetaFamily_eq_unit_relPicMk C (chartTwistClass C m Z) K,
171	      show PicEtAff.map C L
172	            (PicEtAff.unit C K (relPicMk C (overSpec k K)
173	              (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k K) (chartTwistClass C m Z))))
174	          = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicAlgMap C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K L)
175	              (relPicMk C (overSpec k K)
176	                (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k K) (chartTwistClass C m Z))))
177	        from PicEtAff.map_unit C L _]
178	    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C L) ?_
179	    rw [relPicAlgMap_mk]
180	    refine congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)) ?_
181	    -- `relCurveMap C k K ∘ (base change K → L)` and `relCurveMap C k L` are the same
182	    -- whisker, since both are `C ◁ Spec` of the unique `k`-algebra map to `L`.
183	    rw [relCurveMap_base_comp C (K := K) (L := L), Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]
184	    rfl
185	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, hM₀, hθ, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]

187	/-! ## The introduction rule COV-1 uses
188	
189	Read the docstring of `isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness` before editing anything here: it
190	retracts a standing negative result of this lane, and the retraction is what makes the
191	corollaries possible. -/

193	variable (C) in
194	/-- **THE `IsSplitWitness` INTRODUCTION RULE — the one this lane recorded as impossible.**
195	
196	A presenting Čech class over a finite separable `L`, plus a witness divisor inside it, gives
197	`IsSplitWitness`.  Nothing here mentions `θ`, `Σ` or a twist; the twisted case is the
198	corollary below.
199	
200	**This RETRACTS the "no positional introduction rule exists" record** of
201	`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`'s closing note and of the memory item filed with it.  That
202	record was measured, and its measurement was right about what it tested — five variants, all
203	timing out at 1000000+ heartbeats:
204	
205	* `exact`/`refine` with all twelve components as ONE anonymous constructor;
206	* the witness clause pre-bundled as a `have`;
207	* either curve spelling normalised to the other;
208	* `(isSplitWitness_iff_exists_splitting_witness …).mpr` applied to the twelve-tuple;
209	* the trivial splitting `L := K`.
210	
211	What none of them tested is **staging the existentials**.  Introducing them one at a time —
212	eight `Exists.intro`s and a four-component tail — costs nothing at the DEFAULT 200000
213	heartbeat budget.  The diagnosis the old record gives is still correct: the anonymous
214	constructor makes Lean unify the seven instance slots *while `L` is still a metavariable*,
215	re-checking `(relCurve C L).CechPic` against `((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor` on each
216	attempted assignment.  Staging fixes `L` at the first step, so every later component is
217	checked against a closed type and the two spellings never race.
218	
219	**The transferable rule**, and it is stronger than the one it replaces: for a deep existential
220	over types-with-instances, `refine Exists.intro x ?_` repeatedly, rather than one tuple.  The
221	old advice ("restate the definition with one spelling") would have been a large refactor of a
222	co-signed definition; the actual fix is a tactic-level one.  Measured, not inferred: this
223	theorem's own body is the evidence, and the twisted corollary below consumes it. -/
224	theorem isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness
225	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (ν : picEt C (overSpec k K))
226	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
227	    [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
228	    (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
229	    (hM : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K ν)
230	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M))
231	    (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor)
232	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M)
233	    (hW1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)) :
234	    IsSplitWitness C ν := by
235	  refine Exists.intro L ?_
236	  refine Exists.intro ‹Field L› ?_
237	  refine Exists.intro ‹Algebra k L› ?_
238	  refine Exists.intro ‹Algebra K L› ?_
239	  refine Exists.intro ‹IsScalarTower k K L› ?_
240	  refine Exists.intro ‹Module.Finite K L› ?_
241	  refine Exists.intro ‹Algebra.IsSeparable K L› ?_
242	  refine Exists.intro M ?_
243	  exact ⟨hM, W, hW, hW1⟩
244	
245	variable (C) in
246	/-- **The TRIVIAL splitting `L := K`** — the variant the predecessor record singled out as
247	"worth wanting" and reported as unelaborable.
248	
249	At a field where the class is *already* honest, no extension is needed: a witness divisor over
250	`K` itself certifies `IsSplitWitness`.  The record (I-0564) noted specifically that this one
251	"fails for elaboration reasons, NOT because the mathematics is wrong".  The mathematics was
252	indeed fine and the elaboration is fine too, once the existentials are staged — this is a
253	one-line corollary of the theorem above, at `L := K` with the identity instances.
254	
255	Why it matters beyond closing a record: this is the **reverse half of
256	`IsChartDatumPresentation`**, the one residue CHART-U(b) still carries.  The forward half needs
257	a presenting datum's fibre predicate to imply the split predicate; that direction is the one
258	this supplies, since a datum over the base gives an honest class at the fibre field with no
259	extension to find. -/
260	theorem isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness_self
261	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (ν : picEt C (overSpec k K))
262	    (M : (relCurve C K).CechPic)
263	    (hM : PicEtAff.map C K (picEtAffineEquiv C K ν)
264	      = PicEtAff.unit C K (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M))
265	    (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left).CurveDivisor)
266	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = M)

/-! ## The Abel transformation at an affine test -/

section AbelAff

variable (C π) in
/-- The Abel transformation at an affine test, plus-construction form: the étale-unit
image of the relative Picard class of `𝒪(F₀)`. -/
def abelDivPlus (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (F₀ : DivFamZar C A π n) :
    PicEtAff C A :=
  PicEtAff.unit C A (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) F₀.picClass)

variable (C π) in
/-- **The Abel transformation at an affine test** (worksheet §4.1): the `picEt`-valued
form, through the unit of the étale sheafification. -/
def abelDivAff (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (F₀ : DivFamZar C A π n) :
    picEt C (overSpec k A) :=
  relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k A) (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) F₀.picClass)

/-- The affine collapse of the `picEt`-valued Abel value is the plus-construction
form. -/
theorem picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (F₀ : DivFamZar C A π n) :
    picEtAffineEquiv C A (abelDivAff C π A F₀) = abelDivPlus C π A F₀ :=
  picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt C A _

/-- **Naturality of the affine Abel transformation in the test algebra** (worksheet
§4.1: `picClass_mapAlg` + `PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit`): base change of the Abel value is
the Abel value of the base-changed class. -/
theorem abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (F₀ : DivFamZar C A π n) :
    PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ (abelDivPlus C π A F₀)
      = abelDivPlus C π B (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom φ F₀) := by
  letI : Algebra A B := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k A B := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm
  have hclass : (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom φ F₀).picClass
      = Scheme.CechPic.map (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left F₀.picClass := by
    have hcurve : relCurveMap C A B = (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left := by
      refine congrArg (fun ψ : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k A => (C ◁ ψ).left) ?_
      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
    rw [← hcurve]
    exact DivFamZar.picClass_mapAlg B n F₀
  calc PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ (abelDivPlus C π A F₀)
      = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C φ
          (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) F₀.picClass)) := PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit C φ _
    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
          (Scheme.CechPic.map (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left F₀.picClass)) :=
        congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C B)
          (relPicMap_mk C (Over.overSpecMap φ) F₀.picClass)
    _ = abelDivPlus C π B (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom φ F₀) := by
        rw [abelDivPlus, hclass]

end AbelAff
